Our team of designers crafted a matte black wrap for a Tesla, giving it a sleek finish that truly makes it stand out. Check out more below about this car transformation!

Ritchie Eslawa’s 2024 Tesla Model Y features a Matte Black Tesla Wrap, delivering a bold and sleek custom finish.

Matte Black Tesla Wrap Project Insights

A huge shoutout to the talented designers at Branding Centres for their exceptional installation work!
